notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
IMPROVEMENTS
New music has been implemented

The player now has a death animation in which he explodes and the screen has a pull effect

Upgrades can be purchased upon death without returning to the menu

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483520/85610991b6aa68ff6fcc951ff559501f91ea23ce.png"]


HORDES OF ENEMIES
Adjustment in the number of enemies

Adjustment in the number of descents per wave

Inclusion of random events

Some enemy animations have been changed
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45483520/88a9a8c2dbfcfc038db901d01ccd050591c5b018.png"]NEW LOOK
Change in the look of the cover and menus in general
